name: Open Lighting Console
blurb: Open Lighting Console is a free software to control lights on theater shows.
description:
Open Lighting Console is a free software to control lights on theater shows.

Some features:

• Used Art-Net, sACN and Enttec DMX USB PRO to send DMX

• RPN syntax

• Import / Export ASCII Light Cue shows

• Patch / Unpatch by channels or by outputs

• Main Playback

• Chasers

• Groups

• Faders

• Track channels

• Virtual console with easy MIDI learning for controllers

• Open Sound Control

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
